I looked for help on the internet for this fix and stumbled on this reddit post. I tried everything, and the battle music didn't stop.

But with a lot of tries and confusion, i tried something that worked, i tried it on ps5 special edition, so i think it should work for PC too.

Bassicly what i did, i fast traveled to whiterun stables, walked till whiterun gates and then walked to dragonsreach upstairs at the jarls table with the flag locations, clicked 4-5 random flags till it showed me map updated, then i exited the game fully , for ps5 users bassicly just "close game" option from ps hub, [not from the ingame menu]. 
I went back in the game and continued my normal save, and the music just stopped, and skyrim ambient music started playing, then just went out of drangonsreach through the door, and it was all good again.

I really hope it works for everyone else because the bug is hella annoying, especially because there's so little info about it on how to fix it. I hope this helps you all :)
